result:
Only 18 and the 25 pause box (both at 3) improved or held; none of the screens has reached 4 from the critic yet, so this is a partial run.

I shipped three builds:
- **v30.03:** a What's New card refresh ("Polish pass 16"). The gate refused v30.05 until the card stamp was current.
- **v30.05 (cw-setnote):** the rebind callout is now one short line ("Press a button for X · Esc cancels"), with square corners and 20px text. The Settings detail pane no longer repeats the row's value.
- **v30.09 (cw-setname):** the Settings detail pane shows the row name at 20px above its help text. The stepper arrows are now 32px.

I also retargeted the cw-setnote check in `tools/mkfixture.ps1` (commit 0c48627a). It now tests that the pane hides the value rather than the row name.

All three builds passed preflight and the gate, and the seed 4242 fingerprint is unchanged (ents 85/374, containers 165/593).

Critic scores:

| Screen | Before | Now |
|---|---|---|
| 18 settings hub | 2 | 3 |
| 25 raid pause box | 3 | 3 |
| 72 settings display tab | 2 | 2 |
| 75 pad rebind waiting | 2 | 2 |

The 75 score was taken after v30.05 only; I did not re-shoot it after v30.09. The older 3s for 26, 32, 42 and 49 are unchanged, and I did not score 27–31, 68, 69, 71, 73 or 74.

On 72 the critic marks the detail-pane copy as a P0. That text, "Don't use this unless you know what you are doing!", is the help line of the first row, "Edit the words". It is his wording, so I left it alone. The staged shot has no focused row, so the pane shows that stale line.

Findings still open across these screens:
- Tabs are about 17px against the 20px body size, and "Send play data" sits in the tab strip.
- The label sits about 400px from its stepper.
- The scrollbar is 4px.
- Settings has no key-hint strip.
- The "Esc Resume" hint on the pause box is plain text, not a key cap.

All of this is written up in `notes/c-31-ui-pause-settings.md` and `changes.md`.

TASK PARTIAL: no screen has reached a critic 4 yet. Next steps: 20px tabs, a Settings hint strip, a 6px scrollbar and a key-cap hint on the pause box, then score screens 27-31, 68, 69, 71, 73 and 74.
